messages:
maria_cs: heads up — Acme reported a regression: embeddings + rerank quality dipped after last model rollout. customer says recall is down and p95 rerank latency spiked. filing here to triage. :warning:

alex_pm: thanks maria. can you paste the customer summary and ticket id? severity? is this impacting production queries or only evals?

maria_cs: Ticket TCK-8342 (internal link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TCK-8342). Customer reported ~18% drop in top-5 recall on their golden queries after our April 8 deploy. p95 rerank latency for their traffic went from ~350ms -> ~1.8s. They use open-embedding-3 for embeddings, FAISS HNSW on a 128-d quantized index, and rerank-v1 (transformer-based) for final scoring. Customer provided sample queries and approximate timeline. :eyes:

jason_ml: tagging initial thoughts — could be index quantization artifacts or reranker model drift. last infra change on April 8 included quantize-to-8 step for embedding storage and a small tweak to batching in the reranker service. need: repro dataset (customer-provided gold queries + expected results), sample embedding vectors, and histogram of cosine similarities pre/post. can you attach? also want model sha/version for open-embedding-3 they used.

maria_cs: attaching eval set and their sample traces to the ticket now. embedding model version reported: open-embedding-3@v2026-04-06. They consented to us running an internal diagnostic on their data.

priya_se: mitigation options to propose to customer while we investigate: 1) temporarily increase candidate pool (top_k) from 100 -> 250 so reranker has more candidates (cheap config toggle), 2) disable the reranker for this customer and fall back to similarity score-only for ranking, or 3) serve embeddings from the older non-quantized store (if we still have snapshots). tradeoffs: (1) may increase cost and latency, (2) may reduce quality for some queries but lower latency, (3) snapshot restore time + storage ops. I can prepare the feature-flag overrides if we decide.

alex_pm: good list. for product intake/prioritization I need acceptance criteria and impact metrics. proposed RCA/priority criteria: - reproducible top-5 recall delta >= 10% on the customer's gold set OR p95 latency increase >= 1s for real traffic. - affects >= 1 enterprise customer under SLA or impacts >5% of overall production queries for that model. if both true -> P1 and we put on fast track. can we get baseline numbers against a control host? also need owner and ETA for RCA.

jason_ml: initial experiment plan: re-run rerank-v1 inference on the customer's candidate lists but with FP16 weights (no quantization) and compare scores + latency. also compute cosine similarity distributions for embeddings stored with quantize8 vs FP16. if score distributions diverge significantly that's our signal. target: produce reproducible diff and short RCA doc within 48-72h. owner: @jason_ml.

priya_se: I'll prep the feature-flag patch to increase top_k and a toggle to skip reranker per-customer. can push a config change within day once approved. owner: @priya_se.

alex_pm: OK owners set. maria, please confirm customer communication plan and give them mitigation options. i'll create a product intake card and attach the RCA acceptance criteria. We should also flag this for the next eng-week prioritization if RCA points to a platform regression.

maria_cs: I created the intake doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/requests/TCK-8342 (private). it includes the eval set, sample logs, and the customer's permission. I told Acme we'll try mitigation (increase top_k) and will follow up within 24h with an ETA.

jason_ml: quick paste of a short log snippet from their traces (sanitized):

```
[2026-04-09T15:22:10Z] request_id=abc123 candidate_count=100 embedding_model=open-embedding-3@v2026-04-06 index=faiss-hnsw quant=8 rerank_time_ms=1820
[2026-04-09T15:22:10Z] request_id=abc123 similarity_top1=0.71 similarity_top5_avg=0.64 rerank_top1_score=0.92
```

jason_ml: hypothesis: quantize-to-8 reduced embedding fidelity in certain query subspaces leading to worse candidate sets, pushing more burden onto reranker and increasing latency due to more heavy tokens/payloads. if confirmed, fix options: (A) revert quantization for that model, (B) retrain/finetune quant-aware embedding, (C) tune HNSW index params to recover recall.

alex_pm: prioritization call: treat as P1 for now since it's enterprise SLA. target timeline: 72h for RCA and mitigation, patch release in 2 weeks if code changes required. owners: jason_ml (RCA), priya_se (mitigation patch/feature flag), maria_cs (customer comms). i'll escalate to eng leadership if RCA not within 72h. :thumbsup:

eva_opsbot: deploybot: "Canary deploy of embedding-store@2026-04-08 succeeded on canary cluster at 2026-04-08T02:19:03Z"

maria_cs: thanks all — I'll push the customer's acceptance of the mitigation config and update the intake card. i'll ping here once we have the initial repro.

alex_pm: thanks team. keep updates concise in the ticket and ping me for any blockers. :pray:
